segments.name: Medical equipment leasing
segments.description: Provides radiation therapy equipment to hospitals under fee-per-use or revenue sharing contracts, sharing in revenue and operating costs.
segments.evidence: The medical equipment leasing segment, which we also refer to as the Company's leasing segment, operates by fee-per-use contracts or revenue sharing contracts where the Company shares in the revenue and operating costs of the equipment.

segments.name: Direct patient services
segments.description: Owns and operates radiation therapy facilities in Rhode Island, Peru, Ecuador and Mexico that treat patients directly under contracts with the individual.
segments.evidence: The Company's facilities in Rhode Island, Peru, Ecuador, and Mexico are considered direct patient services, where a contract exists between the Company's facilities and the individual treated at the facility.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals pay under fee-per-use or revenue sharing contracts for leased equipment, while individual patients (or their payors) contract directly with the Company's own treatment facilities.
revenueModel.evidence: The medical equipment leasing segment, which we also refer to as the Company's leasing segment, operates by fee-per-use contracts or revenue sharing contracts where the Company shares in the revenue and operating costs of the equipment.
